phrase: a Doctor Booking and Teleconsultation App
verdict: Only with a local focus. Digi Qure from Bhopal pitched doctor booking and video consultation on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. National platforms dominate metros, but smaller cities still have gaps, especially in local languages and specialist access.
angle: Patients in tier-2 and tier-3 cities often travel far to see a specialist. A local platform with trusted doctors and language support can win them. Revenue comes from consultation fees and partner clinics.
